reason: A collaboration plugin for sharing one DSH deployment across projects and users with per-user workspaces, login-gated access, administrative management, and soft session and workspace isolation.

summaries.zh: 为单个 DSH 部署提供按项目和用户划分的工作区、登录控制、管理控制台以及会话和权限隔离功能。
summaries.en: Provides project- and user-scoped workspaces, login control, an administration console, and soft session and permission isolation for a shared DSH deployment.

capabilities: Creates and manages projects and per-user workspaces
Binds workspaces to filesystem directories and creates symlinked user directories
Provides password login and bearer-token session handling
Restricts user-visible sessions, workspace selection, and permission modes
Injects system-prompt and AGENTS.md workspace boundary rules
Provides an administrative settings console for users, projects, and workspace synchronization
